morphology.pattern_note: 按资料包以 sendirian 为直接基词，添加 per-，原有 /s/ 保留；若追溯更基础的 sendiri，也可从 per-...-an 的层级理解。per- 和 sen- 中的 e 读 /ə/；音节字段沿用资料包。

senses.zh_definition: 个人独立进行或自行承担的性质；私人、个人所有或非公共的性质，常置于名词之后作限定语。
senses.en_definition: The state of acting independently or privately; private or individual status, ownership, or provision, commonly expressed as a noun modifier.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal bersendiri tanpa bantuan pihak lain; perseorangan.
senses.nuances: 核心是“个人、私人或独立办理”，不表示性格孤僻。kenderaan persendirian 指私人车辆，calon persendirian 指以个人身份报名的考生；swasta 更突出非政府经营，peribadi 更突出个人事务或隐私，三者并非处处互换。[DBP：persendirian](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=Persendirian)

collocations.zh: 独立报考的考生；私人考生

dual_scenarios.zh: 使用私人车辆的申请人须记录行驶里程，以便申领费用。
dual_scenarios.en: Applicants using private vehicles must record the distance travelled for reimbursement purposes.

etymology.historical_story: Persendirian grows from the Malay family built around sendiri, meaning oneself, alone, or one's own. Its meaning extends naturally from individual independence to private ownership and arrangements outside public provision. Expressions such as kenderaan persendirian preserve that connection: the vehicle belongs to an individual rather than serving as public transport. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=Persendirian)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 sendiri＝自己：自己拥有、自己办理，就想到 persendirian＝私人性质、个人独立办理。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性、较正式的用词，适合表格、公告和职场交流。若想礼貌表示某事涉及个人隐私，Itu urusan peribadi saya 通常比使用 persendirian 更贴切。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于私人车辆、个人所有权和独立报考等语境。不要用它直接评价某人孤僻；公司正式名称中的 Sendirian Berhad 应按注册名称书写。
